versions.content: Use Cases for Sdg Intended use cases for special data are such as • Representing proprietary information within an AUTOSAR model without the need for "sidedcar" files. • Representing information to implement workarounds for deficiencies or features missing in the AUTOSAR meta model. • Representing use case at dedicated places in the model e.g. BuildAction- IoElement ). Application of Sdg depends on mutual agreement between the involved parties.
